overview: The EU-India Innovation Cooperation is part of the European Innovation Council (EIC), which supports breakthrough innovation across Europe through grants, equity investments, and business acceleration services. The EIC funds deep tech startups and SMEs via schemes like Pathfinder, Transition, Accelerator, and STEP Scale Up, offering grants up to EUR 4 million and investments up to EUR 30 million. It also provides access to coaching, mentoring, networking, and global partner connections through its Business Acceleration Services.
geographic_scope: EU Member States and Horizon Europe associated countries
objectives: Support breakthrough deep tech projects with high scientific and technological ambition
Mature and validate novel technologies from lab to application-relevant environments
Develop and scale up innovations with potential to create or disrupt markets
Catalyze major funding rounds to scale up breakthrough innovations in strategic technology sectors
Provide patient capital and strategic co-investments to bridge financing gaps for high-risk innovations
Offer Business Acceleration Services to support market readiness and global scaling
Foster innovation in widening countries through pre-accelerator and widening participation initiatives
Strengthen Europe's deep-tech ecosystem and technological sovereignty
eligibility: Applicants must be from EU Member States or countries associated to Horizon Europe. For EIC Pathfinder: research teams, consortia of at least 3 different independent legal entities from different countries, or single applicants for Pathfinder Challenges only. For EIC Transition: SMEs, start-ups, spin-offs, research organisations, universities as single applicants, or consortia of 2-5 legal entities. For EIC Accelerator: start-ups and SMEs, individuals intending to launch an SME, small mid-caps (up to 499 employees). For STEP Scale Up: single SME or small mid-cap (<500 employees) in EU Member States or eligible Associated Countries (excluding UK), or investors submitting on behalf of eligible companies. All proposals must be submitted via the Funding and Tenders Opportunities Portal.
benefits: Grants of up to EUR 4 million (Pathfinder), EUR 2.5 million (Transition), or below EUR 2.5 million (Accelerator grant component); equity investments of EUR 0.5M–€10M (Accelerator) or EUR 10M–€30M (STEP Scale Up); access to Business Acceleration Services including coaching, mentoring, training, networking, global partner access, innovation ecosystem connections, and venture-building support; Seal of Excellence for unsuccessful but high-quality applicants to facilitate alternative funding; pre-financing payments and milestone-based funding disbursement.
financial_support: Financial support varies by scheme: EIC Pathfinder offers grants up to EUR 4 million plus booster grants of EUR 50,000; EIC Transition provides grants up to EUR 2.5 million and booster grants up to EUR 50,000; EIC Accelerator offers a grant component below EUR 2.5 million and an investment component of €1–€10 million (higher under STEP Scale Up); STEP Scale Up provides equity-only investments of EUR 10–30 million; EIC Pre-Accelerator offers individual grants between €300K–€500K (2025 call) or €500K–€1M (2027 call). The EIC Fund manages equity investments with a long-term horizon (7–10 years, max 15) and follows a blended finance model combining grants and quasi-equity instruments.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to EUR 4 million for EIC Pathfinder, EUR 2.5 million for EIC Transition, below EUR 2.5 million for EIC Accelerator grant component
application_process: 1. Write your proposal (short or full depending on scheme) 2. Submit via the Funding and Tenders Opportunities Portal before the deadline 3. Proposal undergoes remote evaluation by expert evaluators 4. If successful, invited to interview with EIC Jury 5. Interview conducted online or in person 6. Final funding decision communicated post-interview 7. Sign grant agreement and receive pre-financing 8. For investment component, due diligence conducted by EIC Fund and external advisors 9. Investment tranches released based on milestones 10. Receive access to Business Acceleration Services throughout the project lifecycle.
required_documents: Full business plan (max 50 pages for STEP, 20 pages for Accelerator full proposal, 12-page form for Accelerator short proposal)
Pitch deck in PDF format (max 10 slides for Accelerator, 15 for STEP)
FTO (Freedom to Operate) analysis or note
Pre-commitment from qualified investor (for STEP Scale Up and Defence)
Financial plan and agreement document (per EIC template)
Self-assessment document on third-country control (for STEP Scale Up Defence)
Sections 1–3 and cover page of part B (for EIC Transition)
Justification on STEP-related objectives (for STEP schemes)
deadlines: Multiple batching dates per year: EIC Accelerator Open/Challenges: 7.01.2026, 04.03.2026, 06.05.2026, 08.07.2026, 02.09.2026, 04.11.2026; EIC Pathfinder Open: 12 May 2026; EIC Pathfinder Challenges: 28 October 2026; EIC Transition: 16/09/2026; STEP Scale Up: 6. May 2026, 9 September 2026, 25 November 2026; STEP Scale Up Defence: Apply by 28 October 2026; EIC Pre-Accelerator: 18 November 2027.
implementing_agency: European Innovation Council (EIC) established by the European Commission under the Horizon Europe programme (2021-2027), managed by the European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA)
contact_details: National Contact Points (NCPs) in each EU Member State and Associated Country; Enterprise Europe Network (https://een.ec.europa.eu/)
caveats: Grant component of EIC Accelerator can be provided only once during Horizon Europe programme (2021-2027)
STEP Scale Up requires pre-commitment from a single qualified investor covering at least 20% of total target funding round (EUR 50–150 million)
STEP Scale Up Defence excludes entities directly or indirectly controlled by a third country other than Ukraine or an EEA member associated to Horizon Europe, unless guarantees are approved
EIC Pre-Accelerator is restricted to SMEs established in Horizon Europe widening countries only
Natural persons from the UK can only apply for the 'grant only' scheme of EIC Accelerator
Concurrent applications: only one application to EIC Accelerator allowed at a time; additional applications possible after receiving results of original submission
Projects must align with Horizon Europe eligibility: established in EU Member State or Associated Country
Booster grants (EUR 50,000) are fixed-amount and non-repayable but require justification
Investment component decisions take 2–6 months post-grant agreement
Seal of Excellence awarded if proposal meets evaluation thresholds but not selected for funding
